faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about Ispiramy.
faq.come_prenoto: How do I book a consultation?
faq.come_prenoto_b: open their profile, choose a date, length and an open time, and pay. You will get a confirmation by email.
faq.durata_testo: Consultations last at least 60 minutes, with options of 60, 90 or 120 minutes.
faq.video: How does the video call work?
faq.video_testo: The consultation happens on the platform, in a built-in video call. You do not install anything. You will get a reminder before the appointment.
faq.annulla: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.annulla_testo: If you chose to record the consultation when you booked, you can open a dispute within 48 hours after it ends: our team will look at what happened. Without a recording, a dispute is not available. If the consultant declines a booking, the refund is automatic.
faq.diventa: How do I become a consultant?
faq.diventa_testo: Sign up, complete your profile with your skills and experience, set your rate and your availability. Once you are verified, you can receive bookings.

termini.s1_testo: Ispiramy is a platform that connects users ("clients") with professionals ("consultants") for video consultations. Ispiramy acts as an intermediary and is not a party to the consultation between client and consultant.
termini.s2_testo: To use the service you register and give accurate information. You are responsible for keeping your login private and for what happens with your account.
termini.s3_a: Consultations are booked and paid on the platform (Stripe/PayPal).
termini.s3_b: Ispiramy keeps a commission on the consultation price.

termini.s7_testo: Ispiramy is not responsible for the quality or the outcome of consultations given by consultants, who work on their own.
